# temps_project_delivery_settings (Resource)

Which `temps_delivery_profile` a project's traffic uses, with per-environment overrides. Destroying the resource returns the project to the instance default.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_delivery_settings" "web" {
  project_id         = temps_project.web.id
  default_profile_id = temps_delivery_profile.direct.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `default_profile_id` (Number) Profile of every environment without an override.
- `environment_overrides` (String) Per-environment profiles: `jsonencode([{ environment_id = 1, profile_id = 2 }])`. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_project_delivery_settings.web 8
```
